title: #016. Minimum-Cost Set Partitioning
subtitle: Partition all tasks into disjoint chosen routes so every task is covered exactly once at minimum cost.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { selected, totalCost }.
judge.m2: Task {p0} is covered {p1} times (must be covered exactly once).
judge.m3: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed cost ({p1}).
judge.m4: Valid exact partition, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
